prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Preset fallback choices, background render status indicators, and specific onboarding flow reorders (moving sign-in after adoption selection and story teaser prioritization) were helpful.
Interactive waiting screen redesigns, desktop notifications, moving sign-in after photo upload, and full bleed carousel layouts hurt performance.
Copy changes, interaction hints, badges/incentives, new screens, and layout tweaks showed no clear effect.
Predictions were underestimated (too low) for preset fallback choices and background render status indicators.
Predictions were consistently too high for redesigns, notifications, copy changes, hints, incentives, layout changes, and most flow alterations.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -3.5% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +1.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, incentive: -5.1% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +3.8% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -4.9% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +4.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +1.3% over 3 test(s)
- finish, notification: -8.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -4.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.4% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, new_flow: -1.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.8% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.6%

"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Post-Home Desktop Controls Quick Start Screen: Adds a new quick start screen right after home_intro demonstrating basic desktop interactions before finishing onboarding. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or locate pets after completing onboarding.)
1: [sign_in, new_flow] Cloud Sync Sign-In Guarantee Flow: Introduces a cloud backup confirmation flow during sign-in that reassures users their pet will be saved across reinstalls. (why: The largest support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Welcome Overview Intro Screen Flow: Prepends a welcome overview screen before the story intro to clearly explain the app before users choose a path. (why: Choosing path drops 20.7% of users; setting early context helps users understand what pet options exist.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Account Saver Sign-In Copy: Updates the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly state that signing in saves custom pets permanently. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets where users experienced missing pets due to sign-in account confusion.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Tip Carousel Component: Adds a subtle tip carousel hint on the photo upload screen giving guidance on photo quality. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Detail Indicators: Enables progress indicators and notification toggles on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s); clear feedback reduces drop-off while waiting.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Location Notification Hint: Adds a helper button and hint text on home_intro explaining how to locate the pet on the desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails where users reported the pet did not show up on the desktop after completion.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Layout for Adoption Path Selection: Switches the choose_path screen layout to spotlight layout with a step counter. (why: 20.7% of users drop off at choose_path; spotlighting options clarifies the immediate decision.)

scores.note: New screens showed no clear effect in past tests and tend to perform below predictions.
Strong support evidence, but new flows at sign-in previously decreased conversion.
Flow reordering at path selection has proven effective in previous iterations.
Cheap configuration change backed by support themes, but copy tweaks lack positive track record.
High drop-off step with support backing, but hints show minimal historical lift.
Addresses long wait times; render status indicators consistently exceed predictions.
Notification prompts at finish historically hurt conversion significantly.
Layout alterations on choose_path consistently resulted in negative lift.
